notes.title: Version 2.0 Update Released - Patch Notes
notes.content:
The patch is now live adding the following listed below!
This is the first time I've released a patch, so if there are ANY errors please let us know immediately. 
The new version should of uploaded correctly if Steam Achievements are unlocking! 


-Implemented Steam Achievements.

-Player named net persona now displays in some chats correctly.

-Save option now opens right before the Stealth Task on Day #1

-New Save point in town that is literally un-missable.

-Night #1 church street repaired.

-Church Priest and daily dialogue is added. [i](Thanks Mandalore)[/i]

-Hospital side cast cameo is added in the church on Day #3.

-Striker's first FreeFlow chat is fixed.

-Fiona's FreeFlow chat about her icon, has it's second glitched part now added to the initial chat (One of my personal favorites, glad you guys can now see it!)

-The NPC in ZebraTec on Night #1 is fixed. Leading to a hidden event.

-The "Diavolo Girl" quest on day #3 can activate and be completed leading to a hidden end game email with secret information. 

[u]Haze's finalized opening video and credits are not updated yet and will be at a later time.[/u]

notes.title: Upcoming Patch Notes.
notes.content:
I am going through the game myself to make sure all the Steam Achievements pop. 
So you can keep an eye on my profile to see that progress, if you see I've got the final achievement, that means I'm near done.  Now here is a list of all the upcoming patch fixes AND additions!!
However the game now should be FREE! Grab it! But I suggest awaiting the patch to play it!

[b]-Implemented Steam Achievements.[/b]

[b]-Player named net persona now displays in some chats correctly.[/b]

[b]-Save option now opens right before the Stealth Task on Day #1[/b]

[b]-Night #1 church street repaired.[/b]

[b]-Church Priest and daily dialogue is added. (Thanks Mandalore)[/b]

[b]-Striker's first FreeFlow chat is fixed.[/b]

[b]-Fiona's FreeFlow chat about her icon, has it's second glitched part now added to the initial chat (One of my personal favorites, glad you guys can now see it!)[/b]

[b]-The NPC in ZebraTec on Night #1 is fixed. Seeing this scene AND purchasing the cursed rock from ZebraTec allows the "Diavolo Girl" quest on day #3 to be completed. [/b]

[b]-Finalized Haze side opening Video.[/b]

notes.title: November 25th Patch Notes.
notes.content:
File #1 uses an old engine and unfortunately some bugs are unfixable due to the complex internal scripts. But the FreeFlow chat crashes and level graphic errors will be repaired.  Also the Steam Achievements will be patched in.

Since proper understanding of the dual themed story requires players see File #2 it will release early.

Due to voice actor schedules it may only have partial voice acting. With the full voice work patching in when the cast records the full game at once.

File #3 - #13 will be sold as a single DLC.

Please consider each prior release as a demo for each protagonist.
